historical_contract: GSCC transports. GSE interprets. GACR governs continuity.

blocks.label: RAW_CAPTURE_PROVENANCE
blocks.notes: Every captured node remains losslessly queryable.

blocks.label: PLATFORM_PROVIDER_SURFACE
blocks.notes: Provider/platform surface evidence.

blocks.label: PRINCIPAL_ACTOR_IDENTITY
blocks.notes: Observed principal/actor facts; downstream authority remains separate.

blocks.label: CLIENT_APP_INSTALLATION
blocks.notes: Client/App/installation evidence when exposed.

blocks.label: CONNECTION_IDENTITY
blocks.notes: Stable GSCC connection identity usable before GACR continuity exists.

blocks.label: REPOSITORY_IDENTITY
blocks.notes: Repository/org identity.

blocks.label: REF_BRANCH_HEAD
blocks.notes: Branch/ref/exact-HEAD evidence; reused downstream.

blocks.label: EVENT_FIRST_TOUCH_SUBJECT
blocks.notes: First-touch issue/PR/ref/event subject.

blocks.label: WORKFLOW_RUN_JOB
blocks.notes: Workflow/run/job evidence.

blocks.label: PERMISSIONS_ACCESS_OBSERVABILITY
blocks.notes: Observed permissions/access facts, never inferred authority.

blocks.label: CAPABILITY_TOOL_SURFACE
blocks.notes: Declared/observed/tested capability evidence.

blocks.label: SESSION_BINDING
blocks.notes: Pre-GSE: GSCC logical connection/session input; post-GSE: GACR durable canonical binding/reconciliation.

blocks.label: CONTROL_CHANNEL
blocks.notes: Command/ACK/response evidence addressable from GSCC context before durable GACR continuity.

blocks.label: LIVENESS
blocks.notes: GSCC observes liveness evidence; GSE interprets liveness state; GACR persists durable lease/continuity.

blocks.label: ACTIVITY
blocks.notes: GSCC observes activity; GSE interprets current activity; GACR may retain continuity references.

blocks.label: PROGRESS
blocks.notes: GSCC observes progress evidence; GSE interprets qualifying progress; GACR persists continuity/checkpoint references.

blocks.label: CHECKPOINT_CONTEXT
blocks.notes: GSE interprets bounded resumable context; GACR durably retains continuity/checkpoint state.

blocks.label: TASK_WORK_ITEM
blocks.notes: GSCC observes hints; GSE qualifies task context; GACR durably correlates; governed workflow retains task authority.

blocks.label: CLAIM_COLLISION_DOMAIN
blocks.notes: Observed/qualified claim evidence may feed GSE/GACR; final governed claim authority remains downstream.

blocks.label: GOVERNANCE_READ
blocks.notes: Required governance authorities observed with provenance.

blocks.label: ADMISSION_PREAUTHORIZATION
blocks.notes: Admission/PREAUTHORIZED only; no repository or mutation authority.

blocks.label: QUALIFICATION
blocks.notes: GSCC evidence plus GSE interpreted state plus post-GSE durable reconciliation where required.

blocks.label: ACCESS_POLICY
blocks.notes: Fail-closed access policy after required evidence is assembled.

blocks.label: ACCESS_GRANT
blocks.notes: Bounded grant; neither invocation nor mutation authority.

blocks.label: FUNCTION_EXPOSURE
blocks.notes: Existing canonical function exposure gate preserved.

blocks.label: PRECALL_MUTATION_AUTHORITY
blocks.notes: Pre-call and mutation authority remain governed-workflow responsibilities.

blocks.label: CONTINUITY
blocks.notes: Durable continuity after GSE initial interpretation; never a prerequisite for initial GSE state.

blocks.label: FORENSICS_INTERRUPTION
blocks.notes: Interruption/forensic evidence.

blocks.label: TAKEOVER_HANDOFF
blocks.notes: Durable handoff/takeover preparation subject to existing exact-HEAD rules.

blocks.label: ADDRESSABILITY_WAKE
blocks.notes: GSCC observes reachable channels; GACR persists safe durable addressability/wake context.

blocks.label: UNAVAILABLE_NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE
blocks.notes: Unavailable/unknown/denied evidence remains explicit across layers.

gates.label: ADMISSION_ENVELOPE_VALIDATED
gates.notes: Validate admission and PREAUTHORIZED decision eligibility.

gates.label: GSCC_CONTROL_CHANNEL_CHALLENGE
gates.notes: Prove control reachability using GSCC connection context; must not require durable GACR continuity.

gates.label: GSE_INITIAL_SESSION_STATE
gates.notes: Construct initial SessionTwin from GSCC evidence/context.

gates.label: CANONICAL_SESSION_BOUND
gates.notes: Create/reconcile durable canonical continuity session after initial GSE interpretation.

gates.label: TASK_RECONCILED
gates.notes: Durably reconcile qualified task/work context; task authority remains downstream.

gates.label: CLAIM_COLLISION_RECONCILED
gates.notes: Durably reconcile claim/collision evidence without taking governed claim authority.

gates.label: ACCESS_POLICY_EVALUATION
gates.notes: Evaluate access policy over assembled evidence.
